datasets.name: High-resolution remote sensing image data of debris flow and landslides around Wenchuan, Sichuan Province
datasets.source: Zeng, C.; Cao, Z.; Su, F.; Zeng, Z.; Yu, C. High-precision aerial imagery and interpretation dataset of landslide mudslide disasters in and around Sichuan (2008–2020). China Sci. Data 2022, 7, 191–201.
datasets.verbatim: The data used in this article come from high-resolution remote sensing image data, capturing 0.2–0.9 m debris flow and landslides around Wenchuan, Sichuan Province, since 2018 [41]. ... Zeng, C.; Cao, Z.; Su, F.; Zeng, Z.; Yu, C. High-precision aerial imagery and interpretation dataset of landslide mudslide disasters in and around Sichuan (2008–2020). China Sci. Data 2022, 7, 191–201.

methods.name: Van–UPerAttnSeg
methods.summary: An encoder–decoder framework for landslide segmentation. The encoder uses a Visual Attention Network (Van) to extract multi-scale features. The decoder integrates a Pyramid Pooling Module (PPM), Feature Pyramid Network (FPN), and Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) to fuse and enhance features. It also employs a sliding window algorithm based on Gaussian fusion for post-processing.
methods.source: Chang Li, Quan Zou, Guoqing Li, Wenyang Yu
methods.verbatim: In this paper, a new segmentation model based on Van–UPerAttnSeg is proposed for the landslide segmentation problem.

availability.author_statement: "The original contributions presented in this study are included in the article. Further inquiries can be directed to the corresponding author."

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced but not linked, and the custom code for the Van-UPerAttnSeg model is not provided or linked.
